description:
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
2500091 8
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00386124
U.S. BANK TRUST NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, AS TRUSTEE OF LB-IGLOO
SERIES IV TRUST, is the Plaintiff,
and STEPHEN G. ADAMS, ET ALS.,
are Defendants, writ of execution
for the sale of mortgaged premises
dated 01/14/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 22ND DAY of
APRIL A.D„ 2026, at the hour of one
thirty o' clock by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
Property to be sold is located in the
BOROUGH OF SOUTH PLAINFIELD,
County of Middlesex and State of
New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 444 ELSIE
AVENUE, SOUTH PLAINFIELD, NJ 07080.
Tax Lot(s): 4, Tax Block: 312.
Dimensions (Approx): 100 x 100.
Nearest Cross Street : FRANK PLACE.
Important:
Indicate lien information, if any, to
be advertised pursuant to the
Supreme Court decision of
10/28/99 0 Summit Bank vs. Dennis
Thiel (A-58-98)
Sheriff, kindly advertise the following:
Good Faith Estimated Upset Price: $553,656.83.
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of FOUR HUNDRED
SEVENTY FIVE THOUSAND SEVEN
HUNDRED EIGHTY EIGHT DOLLARS
AND FIFTY EIGHT CENTS
($475,788.58) dollars more or less,
plus interest together with the
costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Friedman Vartolo LLP
1325 Franklin Avenue, Suite 160
Garden City, NY 11530
Attorneys
Dated: 3/24, 3/31, 4/7, 4/14/2026
